value.rationale: Finite-time cylinder covering is a natural quantitative refinement of strong transitivity. A fixed pair of observed non-singleton blocks can have an arbitrarily long information-rank plateau merely by moving their separation to p^a, and the theorem exactly calculates the full rank-versus-time profile and sharp filling horizon for every permitted geometry. This is distinct from and not implied by prior isolated/equally spaced probe traces, and has a clear use as a propagation benchmark; it is not a bare renaming of a yes/no classification.
